children: Upexi announced its Chief Strategy Officer Brian Rudick will hold investor meetings at the FT Partners FinTech Conference on September 15, 2026.
Brian Rudick, Chief Strategy Officer, will attend investor one-on-one meetings at FT Partners FinTech Conference in NYC.
Event date and location: September 15, 2026, at Convene, 601 Lexington Avenue, New York, NY.
Company furnished a press release as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K announcing the participation.
Press release information is furnished (not filed) under Item 8.01 and not subject to Section 18 liabilities.
